candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls from inventory time out (~2s), causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway checkout 502s. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory STATUS_CODE_ERROR timeout with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the Redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s with ~2s durations align with redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in traces; topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Redis timeout is the bounded proximate cause; underlying Redis fault unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, CPU) to confirm saturation vs network fault
Gateway logs (excluded) to corroborate error chain
